name: date_slash_short
description: Slash-separated date with two-digit year, e.g. 12/11/26

name: date_slash_long
description: Slash-separated date with four-digit year, e.g. 12/11/2026

name: date_dot_short
description: Dot-separated date with two-digit year, e.g. 12.11.26

name: date_dot_long
description: Dot-separated date with four-digit year, e.g. 12.11.2026

name: date_dash_short
description: Dash-separated date with two-digit year, e.g. 12-11-26

name: date_dash_long
description: Dash-separated date with four-digit year, e.g. 12-11-2026

name: date_text_abbreviated
description: Date with abbreviated month name, e.g. 12 Nov, 2026 or Nov 12, 2026

name: date_text_full
description: Date with full month name, e.g. 12 November, 2026 or November 12, 2026

name: date_month_year
description: Month and year, e.g. Nov 2026, November 2026, or 11/2026

name: amount
description: Numeric amount with optional sign, comma grouping, and up to two decimal places, e.g. 1200, 1,200.00, or 12,00,000.50

name: string
description: Fallback for values not matching another datatype
